name: comp-580
blurb: E-commerce navbar with search, mobile cart badge, category links.
description: Header with logo, search input (desktop + mobile), category nav, cart/sign-in buttons. Mobile menu hides nav, includes cart counter.
use_when: E-commerce or retail app with product search and quick cart access in the header.
avoid_when: Content-heavy sites; search placement competes with other navigation.
a11y: Search input labeled. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Cart badge counts with semantic markup.
